How to play

Mix ideas.
Discover HCI.

Start from eight basic ideas and uncover concepts from human–computer interaction, human–AI interaction and visualization. Every one is a real Wikipedia article.

AddDrop one concept onto the plus side of another to combine them into something new.
SubtractDrop one concept onto the minus side of another to take it away and see what remains.
ExploreTap the name of any concept to open its card and read the Wikipedia article.
